query: How many days did it take Zichen Yan to design the time series processing logic for the backtesting engine, especially the work to rigorously handle corporate actions like dividends and bonus shares and avoid introducing look-ahead bias?
gold: The task started on April 10, 2025, and ended on April 16, 2025, lasting 7 days.
context:
[1] (about=Zichen Yan, episodic, t115 @2025-04-10 09:20:25) Morning all. Regarding the MVO solution, I'm running more backtests with the new 10% liquidity constraint, especially simulating performance in extreme market conditions like 2008, to observe the magnitude and frequency of portfolio adjustments. Additionally, today I'm starting a new task: designing the time series processing logic for the backtesting engine. I'll begin by reviewing the TimescaleDB architecture design previously done by Huiyu Xue, and then sort out the data types we need to handle, such as the processing logic for corporate actions like dividends and bonus shares.
[2] (about=Zichen Yan, episodic, t115 @2025-04-11 09:15:35) Good morning, everyone. Today is the last day for the MVO solver solution. I am currently finalizing the backtesting results and writing the documentation, ensuring all constraints and simulation scenarios are covered. The final version will be submitted this afternoon. Additionally, regarding the time series processing logic for the backtesting engine, I sorted out the data types yesterday. Today, I will focus on designing the data alignment scheme for corporate actions such as dividends and bonus issues. This area, as Boss Li mentioned yesterday, indeed has many pitfalls.
[3] (about=Zichen Yan, episodic, t116 @2025-04-14 09:15:18) Good morning, everyone. For the time series processing logic of my backtesting engine, today's focus is on tackling the post-ex-dividend adjustment of data caused by corporate actions such as dividends and bonus shares. As Boss Li previously reminded me, this area is indeed prone to introducing look-ahead bias, so I will be extra careful in designing the processing logic to ensure the rigor of the backtest. I am currently drafting pseudocode for data alignment.
[4] (about=Zichen Yan, episodic, t117 @2025-04-15 09:14:30) Morning all. I'm continuing to advance the time series processing logic for the backtesting engine. Today, I'll focus on handling ex-dividend and ex-rights data, strictly avoiding the introduction of future functions when dealing with dividends, rights issues, and other situations. Boss Li's reminder yesterday was very timely, and I'll be extra careful with this part of the logic.

I'm currently finalizing the documentation and conducting a final review. I've specifically re-checked the ex-dividend adjustment logic that Boss Li emphasized earlier, ensuring the rigorous alignment of data and absolutely avoiding the introduction of look-ahead bias. I expect to submit the final version for review this afternoon.
